title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user who holds the "Observer" Splunk SOAR role could access a password-reset…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where users with the 'Observer' role can access password-reset credentials in diagnostic log bundles. This occurs because password-reset email bodies are not redacted before logging, allowing these users to reset passwords for active local accounts.
